findings.message: `VerifyContainedDeliveryAsync` performs awaited gate I/O but accepts no `CancellationToken`, so callers cannot cancel verification. Add a token parameter and pass it through to the gate call.
findings.evidenceChecked: The method awaits `RunVerificationGateAsync` at line 72; its signature has no cancellation token.
findings.missing: A cancellation token in the method signature and propagation to awaited calls that accept one.

findings.message: `RunVerificationGateAsync` performs awaited gate I/O but accepts no `CancellationToken`. Add a token parameter and pass it to the gate runner.
findings.evidenceChecked: The method awaits `_preMainTestGate.RunAsync` and `_preDevelopBuildGate.RunAsync`; both calls pass `CancellationToken.None`.
findings.missing: A cancellation token in the method signature and propagation to the awaited gate calls.
